name: qa-evidence-hub
description: QA Evidence Hub — single-owner evidence, findings, observations, and printable reports

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api-client build && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api build && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api-client build && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/web typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api-client build && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api test && pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/web test && node --test scripts/check-digests.test.mjs scripts/sync-sheet.test.mjs scripts/check-format.test.mjs scripts/check-workflows.test.mjs scripts/check-api-service-coverage.test.mjs scripts/check-licenses.test.mjs scripts/verify-cucumber-executed.test.mjs
scripts.test:bdd:foundation: bash scripts/test-db.sh run pnpm --filter @qa-evidence-hub/api test:bdd:foundation && node scripts/verify-cucumber-executed.mjs apps/api/coverage/cucumber-foundation.json
scripts.test:infra: pnpm verify:digests && node --test scripts/test-db-isolation.test.mjs && node --test scripts/f01-containers.test.mjs
